description: This file defines a Razor Pages model for handling user login in an ASP.NET Core application within the Identity area. It manages user authentication, external login schemes, and transfers an anonymous shopping basket to the logged-in user.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: Razor Page model handling user login, managing authentication schemes, validation, and basket transfer post-login.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Nested class representing the login form data, including email, password, and remember-me option.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests, clears external cookies, populates external login schemes, and sets the return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST login attempts, performs authentication, and redirects based on outcome. Transfers anonymous basket if login succeeds.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers the anonymous shopping basket to the authenticated user after login.
